desc: Derive exact gap-alignment characterization and minimum-cost formula (parity/barriers, endpoint/global shift), with proof and pseudocode.
Implement position extraction, gap arrays, and basic impossibility checks such as count1(A) < count1(B) and span/gap feasibility.
Implement the matcher/DP over A gaps and B gaps with states for parity, exact-match barriers, and endpoint/global-shift information.
Implement candidate cost evaluation and handle edge cases: single B piece, no exact matches, mixed-parity exact matches, and endpoint displacement accounting.
Optimize the final implementation to O(N) total time with fast I/O for sum N <= 10^6.
Add a brute-force BFS verifier for small N and random tests to validate the derived algorithm.
